Question #1
```{r}
age <- c(15, 28, 32, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 12, 42, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24, 33, 8)

length(age)

1/age

new_age <- c(age, 0, age) #The new age becomes double the age 
new_age

min(age)
max(age)
```
Question #2
```{r}
rep(c("A","B"), each = 2)
rep(c("A","B"), times = 2)
```
each = Repeats the individual elements inside the vector,
times = Repeats the entire vector,

Question #3
```{r}
seq(1, 20, by = 2)
seq(1, 20, length.out = 5)
```
by = This controls the increment between the numbers and you can use this if you know the precise increment needed between values.

length.out = Controls all the elements and gets the exact number stated and use this to repeat values until a specific total length is reached.
